main.description: A group: an org-owned container context. This record exists only while the context is public; private groups stay in the org store and are never records. The group/event kind split is carried by the NSID itself (com.example.wiki.group vs com.example.wiki.event), not by a field.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique among siblings under the same parent.

parent.description: Optional: the parent context (a com.example.wiki.group or com.example.wiki.event record). Set only when the parent context is itself public; a private parent is simply omitted.
